repos_data.description: VeritasGraph — open-source Knowledge Graph & GraphRAG framework on GitHub. Build multi-hop reasoning, ontology-aware retrieval, and verifiable attribution over your own data. Nodes, edges, RDF, linked-data — runs locally or in the cloud.

sofagent is an open-source FDE Harness — on entry, write your business judgment into files (workflows, ontology, AI nodes); after departure, audit every change against them. 24 git-diff rules, tamper-evident chain, snapshots (107 tools, 11 plugins). Everything can be FDEing — turning FDE labor into FDEing capability.
